text: Brand graphics: Golazo 26 mark, doodles, hero art, ne share-image compositions yɛ adwuma a ɛfiri saa dwumadi yi mu (MIT/CC0) — FIFA anaa federation ahyɛn biara nni hɔ. Team banners ne flag chips de ɔman no frankaa ankasa firi pinned Twemoji artwork (CC BY 4.0, self-hosted), kit palettes nso wɔhwehwɛe. Display typeface: Barlow Condensed (OFL).
